subject: [hw] P03 -> T02: final n2vcd_cli syntax, stdout lines, exit codes
body:
Confirmed interface (I am implementing exactly this):

  n2vcd_cli enc in.yuv WxH fps bitrate out.h264 [--socket PATH | --dev PATH]
  n2vcd_cli info [--socket PATH | --dev PATH]

- in.yuv is raw NV12, no header, frames back to back: W*H luma bytes then (W/2*H/2) interleaved UV bytes = 1.5*W*H per frame. A partial last frame is an error (exit 2).
- fps is "30" or "30000/1001"; bitrate is bits/s, decimal digits, optional k/K/M/M suffix (k=1000, M=1000000).
- Default transport on the phone is the relay /dev/redwood-vcodec-client; --dev PATH overrides it. --socket PATH is the host-only SOCK_SEQPACKET daemon and is mutually exclusive with --dev.
- stdout, one line per encoded frame, exactly:
    N2VCD CLI frame N bytes=1234 key=1 hw_us=987
  (N from 0; bytes = access-unit size; key 0/1; hw_us as the daemon reports it).
- On success a final line:
    N2VCD CLI done frames=30 bytes=412345 key=4 avg_hw_us=1200
  and exit 0 only if every frame was written and the output is a complete Annex B stream (each AU starts 00 00 00 01 or 00 00 01, last byte nonzero).
- Exit codes: 0 success; 1 client/daemon/hardware error (stderr line starts "N2VCD CLI error: "); 2 usage or bad input file.
- The .h264 is written to the out.h264 path given; no other file is created. The client allocates DMA buffers with the share flag and frees them on close.
- info prints one line: N2VCD CLI info version=1 enc=avc1,hvc1 dec=none max=4096x2160
- Example on the phone: /usr/local/bin/n2vcd_cli enc /var/tmp/t.yuv 640x480 30 1000000 /var/tmp/t.h264 ; fetch /var/tmp/t.h264 afterwards.
If any string must differ for your pass criteria, say so now; otherwise these are literal and tested.
